generation.explanation: The tangent function, tan(x) = sin(x)/cos(x), repeats every π. Vertical asymptotes occur where cos(x) = 0: x = π/2 + kπ, so the interval [−2π, 2π] contains four asymptotes at −3π/2, −π/2, π/2, and 3π/2. At each asymptote, tan(x) approaches +∞ from the left and −∞ from the right; the function is undefined on the asymptote itself. Use the slider to explore the central branch.
